name: samebase
description: Build and ship web apps with Samebase through a user-owned GitHub repository, Convex backend, and Cloudflare Workers delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Build and ship apps on the Samebase stack
interface.longDescription: Create, connect, inspect, build, and ship web apps with Samebase. Samebase manages app inventory and provider wiring through MCP while the coding agent works in the user's real GitHub repository and follows its setup, codegen, validation, Git, and deployment workflow.
defaultPrompt: Build a customer feedback dashboard with Samebase
Connect my existing GitHub app to Samebase and finish its provider setup
Update my Samebase app and publish the validated change
